notes.content: The laws-wave end-state is now tracked by a small artifact stack: completed-lanes YAML, remaining-dispositions YAML, source-provenance YAML, manifest-index YAML, compact status JSON, plus artifact index and completion summary. Prefer updating those artifacts together when future law lanes reopen.

directives.directive: Use Windows-safe naming for all generated or stored Vitruvius knowledge-graph documentation and file structures. Do not introduce <, >, :, ", /, \, |, ?, or * in filenames or path segments.
directives.context: Cross-platform modularity requirement from user on 2026-04-18; applies moving forward to documentation artifacts and knowledge-graph-related file structures.
